Document Markdown link rules for Git submodule boundaries (#8922)

## Summary

Add a "Submodule boundaries" rule to the canonical documentation-link
instructions.

- Reject relative Markdown links from a parent repository to nested
submodule files.
- Require canonical absolute `blob/<base-branch>/...` URLs instead.
- Explain why `Test-Path` or local filesystem existence is insufficient
and require Git-tree metadata and web-rendering context.
- Preserve same-repository path and heading-anchor validation.
